operations.description: Uses the selected original query connection. Native ATTACH/DETACH can affect other connections sharing its instance. Rollback does not undo a detached catalog or remove a created file; no automatic reconnect or replay. Paths must stay under the registered root; :memory: requires explicit registration permission.
